title: What to do if your identity or Social Security Number is stolen
desc: Freeze your credit and file official federal identity theft reports.
todos: File an official report at IdentityTheft.gov to get a personalized federal recovery plan.
Place a free credit freeze at all three major bureaus: Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax.
Contact the IRS Identity Protection Specialized Unit to request an IRS IP PIN for tax filings.
Report compromised SSNs to the Social Security Fraud Hotline (1-800-269-0271).
Review your bank and credit card statements weekly and dispute any unauthorized accounts.
